2014_subclasses.draconic-disciple.descri: The Oath of the Draconic Disciple binds a paladin to the ideals of dragonkind. These paladins draw power from their draconic heritage, channeling the might of dragons through their divine oath. They seek to embody the virtues of dragonkind: strength, wisdom, and majesty.
2014_subclasses.draconic-disciple.channe: As an action, you can channel the power of dragonkind to demoralize your foes. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature is frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. (action).

As a bonus action, you can channel the power of dragonkind to augment your strength. For 1 minute, you have advantage on Strength checks, and when you deal damage with a melee weapon, you can add your Charisma modifier to the damage roll.
Have advantage on Strength checks, and when you deal damage with a melee weapon, you can add your Charisma modifier to the damage roll. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.draconic-disciple.aura-o: You emanate an aura of draconic power. Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you makes a saving throw, that creature gains a bonus to the roll equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.
You emanate an aura of draconic power.
2014_subclasses.draconic-disciple.dracon: The power of dragonkind flows through you. You gain resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.
Gain resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.
2014_subclasses.draconic-disciple.dragon: As an action, you can channel the full power of dragonkind, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You have resistance to all damage. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
As an action, channel draconic power for 1 minute: gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed, resistance to all damage, and your breath weapon deals max damage.
